name: Tzunami 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description: Lineage: Zkittlez x Do-Si-Dos Type: Hybrid Terpenes: Limonene, Linalool, ß-Caryophyllene Effects: Happy, Uplifted, Euphoric Aroma: Pear, Chestnut, Nutty Tzunami is an indica powerhouse that hits like a wave of relaxation. With earthy berry notes and a gassy finish, this strain is perfect for evening use. It’s your go-to for unwinding after a long day or catching some deep sleep.
